title: Car-top Dancing
subtitle: It's high time the intricacies of Urban Traffic Code were taught far and wide.

items.text: Car-top Dancing

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: How's it looking, pal? You watching that chick like I told you?

items.speaker: Voice on the Other End
items.text: You mean Mercuria?

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: Give me a break—who else? I'm not keeping up your lifestyle for nothing.

items.speaker: Voice on the Other End
items.text: Yeah, yeah, I'm on it. I've got eyes on her.

items.speaker: Voice on the Other End
items.text: Looks like she brought a buddy along, a loyal little arcanist companion.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: Hah, I know.

items.speaker: Fingers
items.text: Stay on top of that little friend of hers. If she backs out of this job or finds it and doesn't turn it in, you know the drill.
Cheese St.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof, woof ... woof, woof.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Mmm ... whuh—woof ...

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Snarl, whuh-woof ...

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: Patience, Pickles.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: There's a new energy here.
Mercuria empties the newly bought milk into a battered little bowl and pushes it slowly toward a scrap heap by the roadside.
From the garbage, a small nose emerges, trembling as it presses against the bowl with two quick nudges.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof, woof, hrm, woof, woof, woof, woof, whuh-woof.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof ... woof, woof, woof ... woof.
"Beep—beep-beep—beep—" The communicator around the dog's neck buzzes to life.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: Can you hear me, Pickles?

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Grrr, grrr! Woof, woof, woof.

items.speaker: "Doggie"
items.text: The puppy is curious about this device.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: Oh, you mean the communicator? Yes, it guarantees I can receive your latest updates whenever necessary.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Hrrr ...

items.speaker: "Doggie"
items.text: The puppy does not approve.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof, woof ...

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: A journalist needs to grab every tidbit of useful info whenever she can. It's just part of the job.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: Let's get back on track. Have you found MacGuffin the Knife yet?
Soft grumbles escape from Pickles's throat as an indication of his frustration.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: But hey, you've managed to find quite a few strays.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof, woof, mrm-woof, woof, woof.
Pickles casts a quick look at Mercuria, noting how her pants' pockets and backpack are both stuffed with loose bills and money.

items.speaker: "Doggie"
items.text: The puppy is very satisfied with the money they have earned.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof, woof, woof, grrr ... woof.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: I see now. Helping those owners find their missing pets has brought in quite a bit of cash for you.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: But you still haven't gotten your hands on this MacGuffin the Knife, have you?

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: ... Whuh ...

items.speaker: "Doggie"
items.text: The puppy is disheartened.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: Well, it won't be a walk in the park. No wonder this Fingers guy put all his trust in Miss Mercuria.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: My journalist's intuition tells me this trip of yours sounds like it's going to get rough.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: It's either going to be a bust, or you'll end up in deep, or maybe both. Basically ...
The voice on the other end of the communicator hesitates for a moment.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: From a journalist's point of view, I want to keep following your actions, but from an objective third-party perspective, I'd suggest thinking carefully about whether to proceed with this.
On the other end of the line, the journalist waits for an answer.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: Hey, can you hear me? Hello?
The silver-haired girl seems oblivious to the sound of the communicator, her eyes scanning the air as if searching for something.
She abruptly lifts her eyes, drawing focus on the road ahead.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: There!
As fine as a cicada's wing, blending seamlessly with the air, and a tiny shudder, like a black ant.
Low heels reach a quickened pace over the concrete.
Mercuria climbs the railing at the side of the road.
With a quick jump, she lands right in the heart of the bustling, traffic-filled lane.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: Gone, already gone ... and so fast!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Grrr, grrr! Woof, woof, woof!!!
Pickles watches the scene unfold and swiftly follows.
But with the towering fence along the road and the cars releasing dangerous fumes, the little dog can only pace anxiously on the other side of the barrier.
Mercuria has already climbed onto a car's roof, bouncing lightly as she moves from one to another with ease.
Red, white, black, green—her feet tread on the scorching car roofs, like a dance, or perhaps an unusual children's game.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: Southeast, fading fast ...
Eyes shut, Mercuria senses it, whispering softly to herself.

items.speaker: Driver
items.text: What the hell are you doing, girl! It's dangerous up there!
The car owners, without exception, stick their heads out of their windows and begin shouting at Mercuria.
The strands of her hair lift whimsically, and without a backward glance, her words reach the tops of their heads.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: It's alright. Just keep steady.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: I won't fail now.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof, woof—!
The little dog's unwavering loyalty drives him to stay with his companion, even in the midst of danger.
A chorus of car horns erupts as the dog leaps up, soaring over the fence and lands beside the girl.
Their feet press down on the brightly colored car roofs beneath the scorching sun, carving a path from one end of the densely-packed road to the other.

items.speaker: Tracker
items.text: What in the ...
In the dark, a silent tracker stares out in shock.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Grr, grr!

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: South ... black ants and warm currents ...!

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: You know exactly where I'm going!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof!

items.speaker: "Doggie"
items.text: The puppy understands entirely.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: What's going on? Hey, the signal's getting really weak! Whoa! Take it easy. Slow down!
